Meta Folder Structure Update
=========================================

Canonicalized from: `archive/change-records/2026-09-14-Meta-folder-structure-update.md`

Date (original): 2026-09-14

## Summary

Standardized naming, UDI application, and folder layout for `Meta` schema and defaults. This canonical document summarizes the core conventions adopted and directs readers to the archived detailed record for full context.

## Key Points

- Adopted UDI pattern `prismata.meta.ui-schema.<kebab-case>` for UI schema artifacts.
- Standardized filename convention to kebab-case and `.schema.yaml` suffix for shape schemas; registry schemas append `-registry`.
- Moved defaults into `Meta/defaults/ui` and deprecated several old registries in `Meta/deprecated/ui.schemas`.

## History

- 2026-09-14: Detailed structural and naming migration performed. See archived snapshot in `archive/change-records/2026-09-14-Meta-folder-structure-update.md`.
